thread:
mika: quick UX check — in the new pool creation form, should required fields show an asterisk on the label or a strong helper text? the visual weight feels off when the asterisk is tiny :thinking_face:
joel: my vote is label asterisk for discoverability, but increase contrast and use aria-required for screen readers. small asterisk is invisible at 14px tho
pat_a11y: agree on aria-required. also prefer a visible text hint for complex fields (eg. 'dataset id' required + example). a lone asterisk is ambiguous for some users
ellen_pm: product concern — we have a lot of optional-ish fields. adding helper text could clutter the form. can we do conditional helper text only when field is required by policy?
mika: conditional helpers sound good. proposal: asterisk + tooltip on hover that expands to short reason when policy makes it required. default: a subtle asterisk with higher contrast and `required` role for a11y
joel: +1. small implementation note: use CSS variable for asterisk color so themes stay consistent. also we should avoid putting required state in placeholder text (bad a11y)
pat_a11y: nit: ensure focus order includes the tooltip trigger. keyboard users must be able to open the reason. and aria-describedby should reference the tooltip copy, not the label alone
mika: moving on — destructive action copy for delete dataset. current modal: "Delete dataset? This cannot be undone." thoughts on typed confirm vs single destructive CTA?
ellen_pm: typed confirm (type dataset name) reduces accidental deletes but hurts speed. maybe only for datasets with >100GB or production flag
oj el: i'd prefer a graduated approach: for small datasets, show a clear destructive CTA + undo toast; for large/prod datasets require typed confirm + additional checkpoint
pat_a11y: typed confirm is fine but ensure screen reader announcement includes instructions. long confirm inputs should have clear aria-label and live region for errors
joel: also show a summary of consequences (eg. linked projects, uptime impact) in the modal — helps users decide quickly
mika: sounds like consensus: asterisk + improved contrast + conditional helper tooltips; graduated delete confirmations based on dataset size/flags; a11y hooks for tooltips and typed confirms. i'll mock this and share in #design later today :sparkles:
